manualReview.summary: Author maturation TF effects agree with the registered chow P21-vs-P0 contrast (selected 227-TF scope); HFD age agreement retained as supporting evidence; diet contrasts exploratory
manualReview.note: The official normalized CPM matrix is accessible, supports the registered P0/P21 and diet axes, and was rehashed locally (SHA-256 bce4b726...). Authors ran edgeR on raw counts that were not deposited and emphasized P0-to-P21 maturation within chow and HFD. The only supplementary file, mmc1.pdf, contains Supplementary Table 1: 227 transcription factors DE during maturation in either diet, with signed fold changes and FDR for CD0vsCD21 and HFD0vsHFD21. Coordinate-based extraction recovers all 227 rows. The ledgered scoped comparison is p21_vs_p0_chow only: within this selected TF scope it pairs 223 of 227 genes (Pearson r=0.998204, Spearman 0.998717, 222/223 signs agree); Glmp, Kmt2a, Ybx3 and Zfp638 are unmatched. The p21_vs_p0_hfd agreement (223/227 paired, Pearson 0.998265, Spearman 0.998443, 221/222 nonzero signs agree) is retained as supporting evidence only and is not registered, because the legacy one-comparison-per-dataset pipeline cannot hold a second scored contrast. The P21 HFD-versus-chow and P0 HFD-versus-chow results remain valid labeled exploratory contrasts on the deposited matrix with no author comparator. Evidence and reproducible extraction are in continued-sources/GSE135639/turbo-2026-11-15-partial2/.
reviewFlags: Exact author p-values cannot be reconstructed because raw counts were not deposited; author FDR cells are reported as context only.
Selected-gene evidence: Supplementary Table 1 lists 227 maturation TFs only; it is not the full tested universe.

Only p21_vs_p0_chow is a registered scoped comparison; the p21_vs_p0_hfd agreement is retained supporting evidence, and hfd_vs_chow_p0, hfd_vs_chow_p21 and p21_vs_p0_hfd have no registered scoped comparison.
The two maternal-diet contrasts have no author comparator and remain exploratory.
The deposited GEO CPM matrix has no committed source-file checksum manifest; author-result sources are hashed in continued-sources/GSE135639/turbo-2026-11-15-partial2/SOURCES.tsv.

verificationReview.reason: 2026-11-15 scoped comparison against mmc1.pdf Supplementary Table 1 (227 maturation TFs). Ledgered scoped comparison, p21_vs_p0_chow: 223 finite matched effects of 227 (coverage 98.24%); Pearson 0.998204, Spearman 0.998717, nonzero direction agreement 99.552% (222/223), median absolute log2FC difference 0.04184, paired RMS effect ratio 0.951443. Retained supporting evidence, not registered: p21_vs_p0_hfd 223 of 227 (98.24%); Pearson 0.998265, Spearman 0.998443, nonzero direction agreement 99.550% (221/222), median absolute log2FC difference 0.04026, paired RMS effect ratio 0.945113. Selected TF reference; author raw counts are not deposited, so inference is not reproduced. The two diet contrasts remain without an author comparator. Evidence and reproducible extraction are in continued-sources/GSE135639/turbo-2026-11-15-partial2/.
verificationReview.nextStep: Keep the p21_vs_p0_chow comparison scoped to the 227-TF selected reference; p21_vs_p0_hfd needs a scoped multi-contrast route before its retained agreement can be registered, and the diet contrasts need same-comparison author statistics, which are not published.

comparabilityReview.basis: Registered Explorer P21-minus-P0 limma-trend result within chow, fitted on the deposited CPM matrix. The pipeline scores only p21_vs_p0_chow; the p21_vs_p0_hfd agreement is retained evidence that is not registered, because the legacy one-comparison-per-dataset pipeline cannot hold a second scored contrast.
comparabilityReview.reference: Haddad-Tovolli et al. 2020 mmc1.pdf Supplementary Table 1: 227 TFs DE during P0-to-P21 POMC maturation, with FC and FDR for CD0vsCD21 and HFD0vsHFD21. Only the CD0vsCD21 column is scored, against p21_vs_p0_chow. hfd_vs_chow_p0, hfd_vs_chow_p21 and p21_vs_p0_hfd remain without a registered scoped comparison.

cohort.note: Paper reports n=3-5 biologically independent samples; the 17 GEO libraries are chow P0 5, chow P21 3, HFD P0 5, HFD P21 4 and all are registered. No author exclusion list exists.

contrast.note: P21 minus P0 within chow. The caption does not state the sign of the CD0vsCD21 FC; positive author FC is inferred to be higher at P21 from the caption ('up/downregulated during maturation') and the Myc/Mycn/Dbp maturation direction, fixed before comparison.

features.note: 223 of 227 listed TF symbols join exactly for p21_vs_p0_chow; Glmp, Kmt2a, Ybx3 and Zfp638 are unmatched and former symbols are not substituted.

effects.note: Signed author FC converted to log2. Scored p21_vs_p0_chow: Pearson 0.998204, Spearman 0.998717, one sign differs (222/223). Retained, not registered: p21_vs_p0_hfd 223/227, Pearson 0.998265, Spearman 0.998443, 221/222 nonzero signs agree.

inference.note: Author edgeR used undeposited raw counts; registered limma-trend uses CPM. Author FDR cells reported as <0.0001 (56 of 223 paired chow genes) are non-numeric and are treated as missing adjusted P by the adapter; FDR context is limited to the remaining genes. FDR<0.05 among chow pairs is 164 author vs 165 registered, context only.

coverage.note: Selected 227-TF reference scored for p21_vs_p0_chow only; non-TF genes and unlisted TFs are outside scope, and hfd_vs_chow_p0, hfd_vs_chow_p21 and p21_vs_p0_hfd have no registered scoped comparison.

comparabilityReview.criteria: author-concordance-v2 on the declared selected TF scope for p21_vs_p0_chow only: at least 30 pairs, 90% coverage, Pearson and Spearman at least 0.90 or 90% direction agreement. The pipeline scores only p21_vs_p0_chow; no full-result acceptance is established.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: Selected maturation TF effects agree closely for the scored p21_vs_p0_chow contrast; the p21_vs_p0_hfd agreement is retained supporting evidence, not registered. hfd_vs_chow_p0, hfd_vs_chow_p21 and p21_vs_p0_hfd remain without a registered scoped comparison, and full-universe inference remains untested.

additionalComparisonSpec.authorMethod: edgeR on undeposited raw counts; signed linear FC in Supplementary Table 1 converted to log2
additionalComparisonSpec.orientation: P21 minus P0 within chow; positive author FC is higher at P21 (caption and Myc/Mycn/Dbp maturation biology), no reversal.
additionalComparisonSpec.note: Selected 227-TF reference: mmc1.pdf Supplementary Table 1, TFs differentially expressed during P0-to-P21 POMC maturation in either diet; the chow column is used for every listed TF. Rows rebuilt from PDF word coordinates; 227/227 rows recovered. 223 of 227 join exactly; Glmp, Kmt2a, Ybx3 and Zfp638 are unmatched and former symbols are not substituted. Author FDR cells reported as <0.0001 (56 of 223 paired chow genes) are non-numeric and are treated as missing adjusted P by the adapter; FDR context is limited to the remaining genes. Numerical values are recalculated from the unchanged current registered DE table.
